---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest something new or different
title: "Feat: "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**Describe the feature**

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

**Use case / problem it solves**

What problem does this solve? Who benefits, and how? The more specific the better — "I wanted to do X but couldn't because Y" is more useful than "it would be nice if".

**Proposed solution**

How would you like it to work? Include CLI command signatures, API shapes, or UI sketches if relevant.

**Alternatives considered**

Have you tried any workarounds? Are there existing features that partially cover this? Have you checked [ROADMAP.md](../../ROADMAP.md) — some things have already been deliberately decided against (the "What we are not optimising for" section explains the boundaries).

**Willing to contribute?**

- [ ] Yes, I can open a PR for this
- [ ] I can help spec it but not implement it
- [ ] I'm proposing it for someone else to pick up
